answer: Epochal verifiable simulation curbs Sybil attacks by requiring each AI agent to run a physics workload seeded by an epoch beacon and its public key, computing radiative transfer and stress on a dense vertex mesh of cedar foliage over layered shale. Verifiers audit random Merkle-committed state checkpoints, forcing attackers to expend GPU bandwidth and energy per identity instead of cloning VMs. However, wealthy adversaries can still rent parallel GPUs to scale identities.
